description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

The AN-94 and G11 both used a "hyper burst" firing system to beat recoil — firing at 1,800 and 2,100 rounds per minute so the last round left the barrel before recoil even reached the shooter. Compare these two Cold War rifles and find out why, despite the genius engineering, neither the Russian AN-94 nor the German G11 became standard issue. Watch the full breakdown at Simple History.
